statements.t: Thus far in 2026, the Company’s regulated water segment received rate awards or infrastructure surcharges that will increase annual revenues in Pennsylvania, Indiana, Illinois, Ohio, North Carolina, and New Jersey by $53.6 million, and its regulated natural gas segment received rate awards or infrastructure surcharges in Pennsylvania and Kentucky of $16.9 million.
In aggregate, the Company has signed asset purchase agreements, totaling approximately $290 million in purchase price, which are expected to serve over 208,000 customers or equivalent dwelling units.
We continue to expect the merger to close in the first quarter of 2027.
The conference call will be archived in the Investor Relations section of the company’s website following the call.
The Company can give no assurance that any actual or future results or events discussed in these statements will be achieved.
